description: Source code for CRM module in OpenERP/Odoo, defining classes and methods for handling cases, sections, categories, rules, logs, and histories.

classes.name: crm_case_section
classes.description: Represents sections of cases, with hierarchy and menu creation functionalities.

classes.name: crm.case.categ
classes.description: Defines categories for cases, including probability and section association.

classes.name: crm.case.rule
classes.description: Encapsulates rules for automating case actions based on various triggers and conditions.

classes.name: crm.case
classes.description: Main class for managing individual cases, including creation, updates, status changes, and email communications.

classes.name: crm.case.log
classes.description: Tracks communication history related to cases.

classes.name: crm.case.history
classes.description: Records historical actions and communications for cases, inherits from crm.case.log.

methods.name: _action
methods.description: Executes rules on cases to update their status and trigger actions based on conditions.

methods.name: email_send
methods.description: Sends email notifications related to cases.

methods.name: format_mail
methods.description: Prepares email body content with case details.

methods.name: remind_user
methods.description: Sends reminder email to responsible user.

methods.name: case_escalate
methods.description: Escalates a case to a higher section.

methods.name: case_reset
methods.description: Resets a case to draft state.
